::: {#rem-domain}
#### Domain

The set of values a predicate's variable may take is its **domain**,
also called the **domain of discourse** or the **universe of discourse**.
The domain of $L(s)$ in @exr-predicate-values is the set of strings.
A predicate can have more than one variable:
"$x < y$" is a predicate $P(x, y)$ in the two variables $x$ and $y$.

:::
